name: github-personal-stats-vscode
description: Reports what you are working on to the local github-personal-stats daemon, so editor time can be measured alongside agent time.

commands.title: GitHub Personal Stats: Send pulses now

githubPersonalStats.enabled.description: Report what you are working on to the local daemon.

githubPersonalStats.daemonUrl.description: Where the local daemon is listening.

githubPersonalStats.statePath.description: Where the daemon keeps its token. Empty means the XDG state directory.

githubPersonalStats.pulseSeconds.description: How often continuous work turns into a pulse. Keep this well below the daemon's idle timeout.
